title: xtask: collect a per-test coverage map by function with -C instrument-coverage

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
## Goal
Collect an exact map from workspace functions to the tests that execute them.

## Scope
- Add `cargo xtask coverage-map --out <path> [--crate <name>]` in `xtask`.
- Build test executables in a separate target directory (`target/cov`) with `RUSTFLAGS="-C instrument-coverage"` and `CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1` so normal builds stay clean.
- Enumerate test names from each recorded binary (`xtask/src/artifacts.rs`) with `--list --format=terse`.
- Run each test in its own process through the parallel lane pool (`xtask/src/direct.rs`, `xtask/src/queue.rs`), and run `lanes::ISOLATED` targets alone.
- Set `LLVM_PROFILE_FILE` per test process and extract executed workspace functions (entry counter > 0) from each `.profraw` file using the LLVM InstrProf format (`llvm-profdata` or direct reader) without loading the test executable per test.
- Demangle symbols, keep only `camcraft_*` crates, strip generic arguments, and fold `::{{closure}}` suffixes into the enclosing function key.
- Delete each `.profraw` file right after extraction so scratch disk stays below 200 MB.
- Write a versioned, string-interned, gzip-compressed (`flate2`, already in `Cargo.lock`) inverted index (`fn_key -> [test_ids]`, plus `file -> [fn_ids]`).
- Support `--crate <name>` to merge updated crate entries into an existing map.

## Done means
`cargo xtask coverage-map --crate geometry --out <file>` collects non-empty function-to-test entries, removes all `.profraw` scratch files, writes a valid compressed map, and passes `xtask` unit tests for normalization and round-trip serialization.

Part of #2738
